key_big: Line up the places and work from the ones.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write numbers in columns: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones.
  • Regroup (carry or borrow) when a column needs it.
  • Check: 5,302 − 1,876 = 3,426 because 3,426 + 1,876 = 5,302.

Examples

Example

2,457 + 1,368

7 + 8 = 15

5 + 6 + 1 = 12

4 + 3 + 1 = 8

2 + 1 = 3

Answer: 3,825

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting a carried tenWrite it at the top of the next column.
Borrowing across a zero wronglyIn 4,005 − 1,238, break a thousand into 9 hundreds, 9 tens and 10 ones.

faq.q: What is the inverse of subtraction?
faq.a: Addition: it undoes subtraction, so we use it to check.
